scholarships.name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
scholarships.eligibility: High school students who complete an original science, math, or engineering research project and enter the national competition.

scholarships.name: Cameron Impact Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school Class of 2028 applicants who are US citizens, have a minimum 3.7 unweighted GPA, and plan to enroll full-time at an accredited four-year US college.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors graduating in 2028 with a 3.7 unweighted GPA who are U.S. citizens can apply. Applications open February 1, 2027 and close May 1, 2027 or sooner. You need two recommendations and a transcript.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar estudiantes que se gradúen de la preparatoria en 2028, con promedio de 3.7 sin ponderar y ciudadanía estadounidense. Se abre el 1 de febrero de 2027 y cierra el 1 de mayo de 2027 o antes. Necesita dos cartas de recomendación y su transcripción.

scholarships.name: Grad Student Conference Travel Grant
scholarships.eligibility: Graduate students in STEM majors who are paid NSBE members with at least a 2.5 GPA and plan to attend the NSBE Annual Convention GSC mini conference.

scholarships.name: Chevron Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors and first- through third-year undergraduates in engineering or computer science with at least a 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Leroy Callendar NSBE Jr. Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors in STEM fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Honeywell Aerospace Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students in aerospace, computer, electrical, or related engineering fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Graduate Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Graduate students in any STEM major with at least a 2.5 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: NSBE Study Abroad Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Junior, senior, and graduate NSBE members with at least a 3.0 GPA who are studying a STEM program abroad.

scholarships.name: NSBE Jr. Graduating Senior Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors in STEM fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Intel Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: First- through third-year undergraduates in engineering, computer science, physics, chemistry, or math with at least a 3.0 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Cargill Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduates in Regions 4 and 5 in engineering or computer science with at least a 2.7 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: NSBE Fulfilling the Legacy Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors, undergraduates, and graduate students in STEM fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: NSBE Academic Improvement Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors and undergraduates in STEM fields with at least a 2.0 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: NSBE Jr. Golden Torch Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors in STEM fields with at least a 3.5 GPA who are paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Deloitte Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: First- through third-year undergraduates in mechanical engineering, computer science, or related fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and paid NSBE members; renewable for up to 4 semesters ($4,375 per semester).

scholarships.name: NSBE CSP/CGP/Fellows Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students in any STEM major with at least a 2.5 GPA who are paid NSBE members; awards range from $1,000 to $1,500.

scholarships.name: Honeywell Technologies Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Second- through fourth-year undergraduates in engineering, computer science, or technology fields with at least a 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and paid NSBE members.

scholarships.name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Gifted or high-achieving U.S. citizens or permanent residents, 18 or younger by the application deadline, who have completed a significant piece of original work in a submission category.
scholarships.summary_en: Gifted students 18 or younger who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents can apply with a major project. Awards are $25,000 to $100,000. The 2027 application opens this fall, so check back soon.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes con talento de 18 años o menos, ciudadanos o residentes permanentes de EE. UU., pueden postularse con un proyecto importante. Los premios van de $25,000 a $100,000. La solicitud de 2027 abre este otoño, así que vuelva pronto.

scholarships.name: Folds of Honor Higher Education Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: For families who have sacrificed for the country; awards are based on unmet need and require a 2.0 or higher term GPA. The application window is annual, February 1 to March 31, and is currently closed.

scholarships.name: Folds of Honor Children's Fund Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: For K-12 students in families who have sacrificed for the country, covering private school tuition or tutoring; the application window is annual, February 1 to March 31, and is currently closed.
